description: Search U.S. land-border ports in LiveDataLink's self-hosted official BTS Border Crossing Entry snapshot. Returns stable four-digit port codes, state, Canada/Mexico border, coordinates, available crossing measures, coverage, pagination, and source provenance. Use this for 'find the Laredo border port code', 'which Arizona ports have truck crossings?', or to resolve a port before a trend call. Inbound land ports only; not wait times or outbound traffic.

query.description: Port name, state, or exact four-digit port code.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

state.description: Exact state name, such as Texas or New York.

name: bts_transport_search_ports
